messages:
Noah Reed: Quick announcement: we're standardizing role mappings across GitHub orgs, Jira projects, and Redwood Console RBAC to a single canonical schema. Motivation: reduce confusion, simplify audits, and make automated permission sync reliable. Migration window: Sun Jun 6 00:00-04:00 UTC. Migration guide: https://internal.redwood/migrations/role-mapping-2026. Please scan owned repos/projects and flag custom roles. @devex @eng-security

Asha Verma: What happens to custom roles like "release-coordinator"? We have a few repos using it for gated merges.

Noah Reed: We'll provide mapping helpers that translate custom roles to the closest canonical roles (e.g., release-coordinator -> repo:maintainer + ci:trigger). For team's that need an exact mapping we'll offer a short policy exemption period (30 days) and a manual review flow.

infra-bot: preflight checks: jira-perm-sync -> PASS, github-role-audit -> WARNING (7 repos with custom roles), console-rbac-health -> PASS. See /debug/role-audit-1815678901.

Marta Ruiz: DevEx note: we'll add new env var PERM_SCHEMA_VERSION and a CLI to validate current permissions against the new schema: `redwood perms validate --org $ORG`. Will open PRs for the validator and example policy snippets.

Ken Brooks: Ops: will this affect CI pipelines that gate on membership? We have checks that call the API to verify group membership for release jobs.

Noah Reed: Yes — small impact. We'll keep a compatibility shim that accepts old group names for 14 days post-cutover. Recommend teams run `redwood perms validate` in a CI job as part of preflight. We'll announce cutover groups and run smoke tests after each batch.

Asha Verma: Any audit logging changes? We need to preserve who changed mappings for compliance.

Noah Reed: Good call. We'll enable incremental audit events for permission.change, permission.map_apply, and permission.exemption. Events will include actor, timestamp, and diff. Logs retained per org for 365 days.

infra-bot: migration schedule draft: batch1 internal repos (00:00-00:45), batch2 platform (01:00-02:00), batch3 GA (02:15-04:00). Rollback: reapply previous schema snapshot and re-enable legacy group names for affected orgs. Runbook has exact steps.

Marta Ruiz: I'll post PR links: devex/perms-validator #15, platform/role-sync #202. Marking them migration-critical.

Noah Reed: Thanks. If you own any repos/projects with custom roles, add them to the spreadsheet in the migration doc by EOD Thu. Office hours Fri 15:00 PT. Ping @oncall-platform for any preflight failures. :white_check_mark:
